routes.name: Visa-exempt visit
routes.summary: Citizens of many countries (US, Canada, UK, EU, Australia, Japan and more) visit without a visa. Holders of a multiple-entry US, Canada or Schengen visa or a US or Canadian green card are also exempt for up to 30 days.

other: Check the official country table for your passport. Some nationalities need a visa, for example China, India, Nigeria, Egypt, Ukraine and the UAE.
Longer stays need an extension from an Immigration Office.

stay.note: Some passports get longer: 90 days for Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Israel, Japan, San Marino and Turkey, and 180 days for the US.

sources.label: Belize Immigration: do you need a visa

routes.name: Qualified Retirement Program (QRP)
routes.summary: Residency for people 40 and older with steady income from outside Belize. Tax-free foreign income and duty breaks on belongings and a vehicle.

income.note: Or USD 24,000 a year, from outside Belize, in USD, GBP, EUR or CAD.

other: Must be able to stay at least 30 consecutive days each year.
Passes a security check by the Ministry of National Security.
Written undertaking to deposit the required amount in a Belize bank or credit union.
No general right to work. A business needs BTB approval, a business plan, BZD 1 million capital, 90 non-consecutive days of residence and 5 Belizean hires.

steps: Gather documents and forms for you and dependents.
Apply through the Belize Tourism Board.
Pick up the QRP ID card.
documents: Proof of income and bank statement
Medical certificate with HIV test under 3 months old

sources.label: Belize Tourism Board: Qualified Retirement Program

routes.name: Temporary Employment Permit (work permit)
routes.summary: Anyone working in Belize needs this permit. Employers apply for employees. Self-employed people apply themselves. Permits run one week, one crop season or one year.

other: Income tax and social security letters needed.

stay.note: Options: one week or less, one crop season, or one year.

steps: Apply at a Labour Department office.
Wait for a status call, within about 30 days.
Take the approval letter to Immigration and get your fee amount.
Pay and collect the permit, then apply for a Social Security card.

fees.label: Banana, sugar or citrus general worker, 1 year
Seasonal agricultural worker, one crop season
Religious, cultural, educational or voluntary worker, 1 year

routes.name: Temporary Residence (commercial investment)
routes.summary: One-year renewable residence for people investing in Belize who cannot meet the normal permanent residence rules because of commitments abroad.

routes.name: Investor Residence Program (proposed)
routes.summary: A proposed framework dated October 2026 with a USD 500,000 minimum investment. It may not be open yet.

other: Must spend 12 months in Belize over a three-year period.
Described as a proposed framework, so not confirmed as in effect. Fees not listed.

routes.name: Permanent Residence
routes.summary: Apply after at least 1 year of legal residence in Belize, with no more than 14 days out of the country in that year. Minors who arrived under 16 may qualify after 10 years.

other: Show you are and will stay financially stable.
No conviction for an offence with a sentence of 12 months or more, unless pardoned.
Medical exam and HIV, VDRL and TB tests, police record, bank statements and photos required.
Fees not confirmed. See the Residence Fees page.

documents: Passport with arrival stamp at least 1 year old
